messages.author: 694861b2626f028e
messages.subject: inla.get.poisson.data.1
parts:
Hello INLA-team, and everyone,
 
I've just downloaded the lastest version of the INLA package,and I wanted to use a function expand.dataframe for survival modelling purpose. But I couldn't because the lastest version of INLA didn't contain the "inla.get.poisson.data.1" function.
Fortunately, I'v in my possession an older INLA version, but is it possible to include this function in the latest package?
 
Thanks,
 
Regards,
Khalid

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.get.poisson.data.1
parts:
On Sat, 2013-11-30 at 06:05 -0800, aityahi...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hello INLA-team, and everyone,
>
> I've just downloaded the lastest version of the INLA package,and I
> wanted to use a function expand.dataframe for survival modelling
> purpose. But I couldn't because the lastest version of INLA didn't
> contain the "inla.get.poisson.data.1" function.
> Fortunately, I'v in my possession an older INLA version, but is it
> possible to include this function in the latest package?
>

hi,

since R-3.0 the namespace spesification was required, and this function
is not exported, so INLA:::inla.get.poisson.data.1 will give you what
you ask for.

maybe ?inla.coxph, which is a newer interface is easier to use.

Best
H
